test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The painting was admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.

options.text: The painting was being admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.
Art enthusiasts from around the world admired the painting.
Art enthusiasts from around the world have admired the painting.
The painting has been admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is:** "The painting was admired by art enthusiasts from around the world."**
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject **"art enthusiasts from around the world"** at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form** "was admired" **to the active verb form** "admired."**
 
• Place the object** "the painting"** after the verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** ***"Art enthusiasts from around the world admired the painting."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The painting was being admired by art enthusiasts from around the world." – Incorrect as it is still in passive voice and uses the past continuous tense.
 
• **Option 3:** "Art enthusiasts from around the world have admired the painting." – Incorrect tense; uses present perfect which is not needed for this sentence.
 
• **Option 4:** "The painting has been admired by art enthusiasts from around the world." – Incorrect as it is still in passive voice and uses present perfect tense.
